alive.last_commit_message:
Share one gateway execution gate between concurrent calls; repair harness tests (#1154)

* Repair eleven harness test files left stale by the async storage move

#939 made storage and services async and these harness, Claude, Grok and
native-hook suites outside CI's focused selection never followed: rewritten
fake constructors are back to __init__, prepare_chat, activity events and
start_chat_turn tasks are awaited, polling helpers accept async predicates,
stubs Core awaits are async, time.sleep became asyncio.sleep, and the SQL
plan capture goes through the aiosqlite adapter. Stale expectations cite their
change: scripted Grok writes its session system head (cea8b38) in an isolated
home, a blocked goal's runtime switch applies at once, a superseded session
may close (#572), and under the never policy the bypass reason and override
of explicit MCP denies follow #1125's documented behaviour.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Repair test_harnesses.py after the async storage move

Async fixes in the shared harness suite: awaited prepare_chat and turn tasks,
async stubs Core now awaits, polling helpers with async predicates, and stale
expectations cited in the companion commit (cea8b38, #572, #1125). The
unattached-session fixture now uses a neutral synthetic name.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Share one gateway execution gate between concurrent action calls

_gateway_execution_gate checked for a turn's gate, then awaited the run,
project and scope reads before storing a new semaphore. Since #939 those
reads yield, so two overlapping calls could each store their own gate and run
gateway action calls concurrently past the project's concurrency limit. The
gate is now stored with setdefault, so every caller shares the first one.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
